name: Aider
description: AI pair programming in the terminal. Installed with pip into the tools volume (pipx/uv deferred).
install: python3 -m pip install --upgrade --target {{prefix}}/py {{package_spec}}; mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'export PYTHONPATH="{{prefix}}/py:${PYTHONPATH:-}"' 'exec python3 -m aider "$@"' > {{prefix}}/bin/aider; chmod +x {{prefix}}/bin/aider
upgrade: python3 -m pip install --upgrade --target {{prefix}}/py {{package_spec}}; mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'export PYTHONPATH="{{prefix}}/py:${PYTHONPATH:-}"' 'exec python3 -m aider "$@"' > {{prefix}}/bin/aider; chmod +x {{prefix}}/bin/aider
detect: command -v aider >/dev/null && (aider --version 2>/dev/null || PYTHONPATH={{prefix}}/py python3 -c 'import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version("aider-chat"))' 2>/dev/null) | head -1
